# 🌌 Title

## OGSound — Fortnite Chapter 1 Ambient Music Pack

---

## 🎮 Relive the Golden Era of Fortnite Inside Minecraft

OGSound transforms Minecraft’s atmosphere using iconic ambient music inspired by **Fortnite Chapter 1**.

Using the **Reactive Music** mod, the soundtrack dynamically changes depending on exploration, villages, caves, dimensions, altitude, day/night cycles, and more.

From nostalgic daytime ambience to calm nighttime melodies, this pack recreates the classic Chapter 1 feeling directly in Minecraft.

Perfect for:

* Survival servers
* OG / nostalgic modpacks
* Chill exploration gameplay
* Fortnite-inspired worlds
* Relaxing building sessions

---

## 🎵 Features

* Dynamic Fortnite-inspired ambient music
* Day & night soundtrack transitions
* Cave & underground ambience
* Nether atmosphere music
* Village ambience
* High altitude exploration music
* Seamless Reactive Music integration


---

## 📦 Requirements

This resource pack requires:

[Reactive Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/reactive-music)

Without the mod, the pack will not work correctly.

## 📥 Installation

1. 1️⃣ Download the Reactive Music Mod
1. 2️⃣ Download NookOST
1. 3️⃣ Drag the downloaded .zip file into your resourcepacks folder

```
.minecraft/resourcepacks
```

1. 4️⃣ Launch Minecraft
1. 5️⃣ Open the Reactive Music settings

You can access it by:

Using Mod Menu

Typing the command:


```
/reactivemusic
```

---

## 🎵 Soundtrack

This pack includes music inspired by:

Fornite Chapter 1
